mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 5% and a fall in PAYEMS below its 6-month moving average signals labor market imbalances, which increase cost pressures and reduce hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 3-month moving averages for two consecutive months signals weakening housing and overall demand, which depresses consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 3-month MA AND HOUST < 3-month MA for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.5 percentage points signals an unexpected tightening, which immediately raises risk-free rates and equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in INDPRO below its 6-month moving average for three consecutive months, combined with a decline in RSAFS, signals broad supply chain weakness and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 6-month MA for 3 consecutive months AND RSAFS < 6-month MA
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered episodes.
